description: This script fetches pull request data from GitHub, processes contributor information, and updates YAML files with top contributors, translators, and reviewers. It also automates creating a pull request with these updates.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: LabelNode
classes.description: Represents a label node in GitHub PR labels.

classes.name: Labels
classes.description: Contains a list of label nodes.

classes.name: ReviewNode
classes.description: Represents a review on a pull request, including author and review state.

classes.name: Reviews
classes.description: Contains a list of review nodes.

classes.name: PullRequestNode
classes.description: Represents a GitHub pull request with metadata, labels, author, reviews, and status.

classes.name: PullRequestEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the pull request connection, including cursor and node.

classes.name: PullRequests
classes.description: Contains a list of pull request edges.

classes.name: PRsRepository
classes.description: Represents the repository data containing pull requests.

classes.name: PRsResponseData
classes.description: Wraps repository data in the GraphQL response.

classes.name: PRsResponse
classes.description: Represents the full GraphQL response data structure.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class for GitHub token, repository, and HTTP timeout.

classes.name: ContributorsResults
classes.description: Holds counters of contributors, translators, reviewers, and a dictionary of authors.

methods.name: get_graphql_response
methods.description: Sends a GraphQL request to GitHub API and returns the response data.

methods.name: get_graphql_pr_edges
methods.description: Retrieves pull request edges from GitHub GraphQL API.

methods.name: get_pr_nodes
methods.description: Collects all pull request nodes by paginating through GraphQL responses.

methods.name: get_contributors
methods.description: Analyzes pull request nodes to count contributors, translators, and reviewers.

methods.name: get_users_to_write
methods.description: Filters and formats user data based on contribution counts.

methods.name: update_content
methods.description: Updates YAML files with new contributor data if changed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching data, updating files, and creating a pull request.
